messages.subject: Project Umbra - validity & FTO confirmation
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena, Sofia,

Formal validity and freedom-to-operate confirmation attached for signing. The four granted members are valid and in force; the two pending US/EP equivalents are progressing. No matter that would prevent Caspian granting the exclusive licence.

Alan
